notes: Two branches meet at «سفيان» («أخبرنا» and «قالوا حدثنا»): the names after it are the shared tail, written once (rule 3)
«قال أبو داود» is the compiler's remark: not written (rule 13)
«واقد بن محمد ... عن أبيه أو عن محمد بن سهل عن النبي» gives two versions: the father («أبيه», a relation) and the direct line; both are variant groups, not routes
«قال بعضهم عن نافع بن جبير عن سهل بن سعد» names a different Companion for the same saying: a variant group; «بعضهم» is unnamed
«يبلغ به النبي» reports that the chain reaches the Prophet; no gap link is added (rule 12)
